value.rationale: The inverse question for the full all-odd-q irreducible-character degree spectrum is natural and mathematically motivated: can these complete representation statistics reconstruct a connected tree graphical Lie algebra? The explicit collision disproves recovery, and the exhaustive first-instance cutoff of ten vertices/19 Lie dimensions is sharp within the infinite tree family. This is not an arbitrary single-field parameter slice or a trivial restatement of the known forward formula.
